<p dir="auto">To install from a Julia REPL:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="julia&gt; ]

pkg&gt; add TurbulentWords

pkg&gt; instantiate"><pre>julia<span class="pl-k">&gt;</span> ]

pkg<span class="pl-k">&gt;</span> add TurbulentWords

pkg<span class="pl-k">&gt;</span> instantiate</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">TurbulentWords.jl requires Julia v1.6 or later but we encourage using Julia v1.10.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 class="heading-element" dir="auto">A turbulent flow</h3><a id="user-content-a-turbulent-flow" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: A turbulent flow" href="#a-turbulent-flow"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">We can compute the two-dimensional incompressible velocity field whose vorticity is a given word.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="using TurbulentWords
using Oceananigans
using CairoMakie

u, v, ψ, ζ = word_to_flow(&quot;TEMPESTUOUS&quot;, vpad=50)

fig = Figure(size = (800, 800))

ax1 = Axis(fig[1, 1], title=&quot;Vorticity, ∂v/∂x - ∂u/∂y&quot;)
ax2 = Axis(fig[2, 1], title=&quot;Streamfunction, ψ&quot;)
ax3 = Axis(fig[3, 1], title=&quot;u = - ∂ψ/∂y&quot;)
ax4 = Axis(fig[4, 1], title=&quot;v = + ∂ψ/∂x&quot;)

[hidedecorations!(ax) for ax in (ax1, ax2, ax3, ax4)]

heatmap!(ax1, interior(ζ, :, :, 1), colormap=:balance, colorrange = (-1.2, 1.2))
heatmap!(ax2, interior(ψ, :, :, 1), colormap=:speed)
heatmap!(ax3, interior(u, :, :, 1), colormap=:balance)
heatmap!(ax4, interior(v, :, :, 1), colormap=:balance)

fig"><pre><span class="pl-k">using</span> TurbulentWords
<span class="pl-k">using</span> Oceananigans
<span class="pl-k">using</span> CairoMakie

u, v, ψ, ζ <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">word_to_flow</span>(<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>TEMPESTUOUS<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>, vpad<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">50</span>)

fig <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">Figure</span>(size <span class="pl-k">=</span> (<span class="pl-c1">800</span>, <span class="pl-c1">800</span>))

ax1 <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">Axis</span>(fig[<span class="pl-c1">1</span>, <span class="pl-c1">1</span>], title<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>Vorticity, ∂v/∂x - ∂u/∂y<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>)
ax2 <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">Axis</span>(fig[<span class="pl-c1">2</span>, <span class="pl-c1">1</span>], title<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>Streamfunction, ψ<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>)
ax3 <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">Axis</span>(fig[<span class="pl-c1">3</span>, <span class="pl-c1">1</span>], title<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>u = - ∂ψ/∂y<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>)
ax4 <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">Axis</span>(fig[<span class="pl-c1">4</span>, <span class="pl-c1">1</span>], title<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>v = + ∂ψ/∂x<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>)

[<span class="pl-c1">hidedecorations!</span>(ax) <span class="pl-k">for</span> ax <span class="pl-k">in</span> (ax1, ax2, ax3, ax4)]

<span class="pl-c1">heatmap!</span>(ax1, <span class="pl-c1">interior</span>(ζ, :, :, <span class="pl-c1">1</span>), colormap<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">:balance</span>, colorrange <span class="pl-k">=</span> (<span class="pl-k">-</span><span class="pl-c1">1.2</span>, <span class="pl-c1">1.2</span>))
<span class="pl-c1">heatmap!</span>(ax2, <span class="pl-c1">interior</span>(ψ, :, :, <span class="pl-c1">1</span>), colormap<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">:speed</span>)
<span class="pl-c1">heatmap!</span>(ax3, <span class="pl-c1">interior</span>(u, :, :, <span class="pl-c1">1</span>), colormap<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">:balance</span>)
<span class="pl-c1">heatmap!</span>(ax4, <span class="pl-c1">interior</span>(v, :, :, <span class="pl-c1">1</span>), colormap<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">:balance</span>)

fig</pre></div>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 class="heading-element" dir="auto">A turbulent simulation</h3><a id="user-content-a-turbulent-simulation" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: A turbulent simulation" href="#a-turbulent-simulation"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="using TurbulentWords
using Oceananigans
using CairoMakie

simulation = word_to_simulation(&quot;STORMY&quot;)
simulation.stop_time = 5
run!(simulation)

model = simulation.model
u, v, w = model.velocities
ζ = Field(∂x(v) - ∂y(u)) |&gt; compute!

fig = Figure()
ax = Axis(fig[1, 1])
hidedecorations!(ax)
heatmap!(ax, interior(ζ, :, :, 1), colormap=:balance)

fig"><pre><span class="pl-k">using</span> TurbulentWords
<span class="pl-k">using</span> Oceananigans
<span class="pl-k">using</span> CairoMakie

simulation <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">word_to_simulation</span>(<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>STORMY<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>)
simulation<span class="pl-k">.</span>stop_time <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">5</span>
<span class="pl-c1">run!</span>(simulation)

model <span class="pl-k">=</span> simulation<span class="pl-k">.</span>model
u, v, w <span class="pl-k">=</span> model<span class="pl-k">.</span>velocities
ζ <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">Field</span>(<span class="pl-c1">∂x</span>(v) <span class="pl-k">-</span> <span class="pl-c1">∂y</span>(u)) <span class="pl-k">|&gt;</span> compute!

fig <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">Figure</span>()
ax <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">Axis</span>(fig[<span class="pl-c1">1</span>, <span class="pl-c1">1</span>])
<span class="pl-c1">hidedecorations!</span>(ax)
<span class="pl-c1">heatmap!</span>(ax, <span class="pl-c1">interior</span>(ζ, :, :, <span class="pl-c1">1</span>), colormap<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">:balance</span>)

fig</pre></div>
<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/15271942/280408611-9f5c4f4c-4306-4dbc-a72f-2bf41c250b92.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..Uq4sh9aB41NchuFY-R1xr7FPCuVBBw3iZp4epe_GAzw"><img src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/15271942/280408611-9f5c4f4c-4306-4dbc-a72f-2bf41c250b92.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..Uq4sh9aB41NchuFY-R1xr7FPCuVBBw3iZp4epe_GAzw" alt="image" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 class="heading-element" dir="auto">Another turbulent simulation</h3><a id="user-content-another-turbulent-simulation" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Another turbulent simulation" href="#another-turbulent-simulation"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="using TurbulentWords
using Oceananigans
using CairoMakie

simulation = word_to_simulation(&quot;ROILING&quot;, dynamics=:buoyancy_driven)
simulation.stop_time = 0.3
run!(simulation)

b = simulation.model.tracers.b

fig = Figure()
ax = Axis(fig[1, 1])
hidedecorations!(ax)
heatmap!(ax, interior(b, :, 1, :), colormap=:balance)

fig"><pre><span class="pl-k">using</span> TurbulentWords
<span class="pl-k">using</span> Oceananigans
<span class="pl-k">using</span> CairoMakie

simulation <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">word_to_simulation</span>(<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>ROILING<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>, dynamics<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">:buoyancy_driven</span>)
simulation<span class="pl-k">.</span>stop_time <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">0.3</span>
<span class="pl-c1">run!</span>(simulation)

b <span class="pl-k">=</span> simulation<span class="pl-k">.</span>model<span class="pl-k">.</span>tracers<span class="pl-k">.</span>b

fig <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">Figure</span>()
ax <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">Axis</span>(fig[<span class="pl-c1">1</span>, <span class="pl-c1">1</span>])
<span class="pl-c1">hidedecorations!</span>(ax)
<span class="pl-c1">heatmap!</span>(ax, <span class="pl-c1">interior</span>(b, :, <span class="pl-c1">1</span>, :), colormap<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">:balance</span>)

fig</pre></div>
